hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *go/*.go|*go/go.mod|*go/go.sum) cd /workspaces/san-db-ox-clients && make go-build ;; esac; }

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *python/*.py|*python/pyproject.toml) cd /workspaces/san-db-ox-clients && make python-lint && make python-typecheck ;; esac; }

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *typescript/*.ts|*typescript/package.json) cd /workspaces/san-db-ox-clients && make typescript-typecheck ;; esac; }
jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *rust/*.rs|*rust/Cargo.toml) cd /workspaces/san-db-ox-clients && make rust-build ;; esac; }
jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *java/*.java|*java/pom.xml) cd /workspaces/san-db-ox-clients && make java-build ;; esac; }
